title: Bounded client-observed query/body field candidates
sourceContract: Client request-construction evidence only; not server requiredness, validation, complete response modeling, or universal request shape.

normalizedFields.name: dateFrom
normalizedFields.evidence: Calendar caller #42300 formats the month start with format('Y-MM-DD') and writes dateFrom at eliis.hasm line 1715586, bytecode offset 0x75; duplicate caller #42323 does the same at line 1716934, offset 0x75.

normalizedFields.name: dateTo
normalizedFields.evidence: Calendar caller #42300 formats the month end with format('Y-MM-DD') and writes dateTo at eliis.hasm line 1715596, bytecode offset 0xa4; duplicate caller #42323 does the same at line 1716944, offset 0xa4.

clientRequestVariants.evidence: #42300/#42323 -> #25373/#25374 -> installed service #25403; routeChain and normalizedFields give exact constructor writes, argument registers, global lines and function-local offsets. Two own query keys locally complete; arbitrary additional caller keys remain unresolved.
routeChain: UI calendar caller #42300/#42323 constructs a fresh object with dateFrom/dateTo and calls getEvents at offsets 0xa9 (eliis.hasm lines 1715597 and 1716945).

Action creator #25373 captures explicit parameter 1 at eliis.hasm line 994660, offset 0x02, and returns thunk #25374; #25374 selects the kindergarten and forwards that captured query as service argument 2 at line 994695, offset 0x59.

Service method #25403 is at communications.hasm lines 877-913 (global eliis.hasm line 995342, function bytecode offset 0); parameter 2 is shallow-copied with Object.assign({}, arg2) and assigned to Axios config.params at offsets 0x4d-0x62, then Axios get is called at 0x66.
clientRequestVariants.branch: Both identified calendar constructors create dateFrom/dateTo for month start/end. The API wrapper uses an empty params object if argument 2 is undefined/omitted; otherwise it shallow-copies the passed value. The UI-constructor path is evidenced, not exhaustive for all possible callers.

notes: Do not treat dateFrom/dateTo as the exhaustive universal query schema: the service forwards any other enumerable keys on an arbitrary caller argument.

body.evidence: #39305 builds exactly fourteen own keys in register 5 at 1582886-1582966 and sends it to insertWorkSchedule at 1582987, 0x1e0. Captured edit flag slot 12 must be falsy at 1582978-1582979, 0x1bb-0x1bf; duration assignment requires that same flag truthy at 1582967-1582973, 0x186-0x1a2, so insert excludes duration. #26526 copies at 1029996, 0x31; truthy full_day skips conversion (0x37-0x3d), preserving null times. Otherwise it copies only #25412.date/time into start_date/start_time/end_time (1030028-1030032, 0xce/0xda/0xe6), not request tz/date/time names. Service call 1030038, 0x103; #26547 loads data parameter 2 at 1030629, 0x30, and calls Axios POST at 1030630, 0x33. Complete only for these observed own constructor keys, before serialization; other callers remain unresolved.

clientRequestVariants.evidence: #39305 register 5 -> #26525/#26526 copied register 4 -> #26547 parameter 2, Axios POST 1030630, 0x33. Fourteen own keys locally complete on insert; duration excluded by opposite edit flag, range undefined values still own, full-day null times preserved. Field and body evidence record exact source lines/offsets; other callers remain partial.
clientRequestVariants.localCompleteness: fourteen own keys on observed insert paths, before serialization; not universal caller coverage
routeChain: #39305 builds register 5 at 1582886-1582966 and sends it at 1582987, 0x1e0; edit flag slot 12 falsy excludes duration assigned only under truthy flag at 1582967-1582973.

M2289/#26515 dependencies [1,1229,2290,2228] at 11570-11573: dependency 3=M2228/#25411 exports #25412 at 995548-995549, 0x84-0x89. #26526 copies at 1029996, 0x31, skips full-day conversion at 0x3d, otherwise writes only start_date/start_time/end_time at 0xce/0xda/0xe6; service call 1030038, 0x103.
M2290/#26544/#26545/class #26546 binds #26547; Axios POST data is parameter 2, loaded at 1030629, 0x30, call 1030630, 0x33.
clientRequestVariants.branch: Exactly fourteen own keys on every executed observed insert path, including range keys whose values may be undefined. Edit flag slot 12 is falsy for insert and truthy for selected-data duration assignment, so duration is excluded, as are update-only id/date/end_date/exception_date. Full-day null times survive the action.

notes: The client Object.assign copy must not be interpreted as a server schema; the complete flag is scoped to this locally traced constructor only.

body.evidence: Nineteen-name possible-key union, not nineteen simultaneous keys. #39305 calls difference(base register 5, captured selectedData slot 8) at 1583003, 0x22b, storing result in register 4. #25432/#25433/#25434 compare selectedData[key] and omit equal values (996255-996258, 0x19-0x25, target 0x71); unequal scalar/object differences are written at 996276, 0x6d, with recursive object branch 0x28-0x64 and transform accumulator #25436 (996300-996401). Branches restore/add/delete keys at 1583012-1583069. Only id and employee_id are always assigned after filtering at 1583073/1583075, 0x398/0x3a4. Update call passes difference register 4 at 1583085, 0x3d1. #26530 copies it at 1030125, 0x37, preserves full-day null times or conditionally copies #25412 formatted results into start_date/start_time/end_time, then service call 1030200, 0x19d. #26551 reads body.id at 1030699, 0x15, and sends the same body register 3 as PUT data at 1030707, 0x39. Local completeness covers only the traced possible-key union and omission/branch mechanisms; operation coverage stays partial and other callers unresolved.

clientRequestVariants.evidence: #39305 difference register 4 -> #26529/#26530 copy -> installed #26551 PUT same body register 3 at 1030707, 0x39. #25432/#25433/#25434/#25436 omit equal keys; routeChain, body and normalizedFields cite filtering and branch writes. Locally complete possible-key union only: nineteen names, seventeen conditional, id/employee_id always post-filter assigned; caller coverage partial.
clientRequestVariants.localCompleteness: complete traced nineteen-name possible-key union plus difference/branch omission mechanisms, never nineteen simultaneous keys or universal caller coverage
routeChain: #39305 builds base register 5 at 1582886-1582973; difference(base, selectedData) at 1583003, 0x22b, produces register 4 with equal keys omitted; subsequent branch mutations and final id/employee_id writes precede updateWorkSchedule(register4) at 1583085, 0x3d1.

M4116 dependencies at 20705-20708: index 24=M2228/#25411 exports difference #25432 at 995596-995597; #25433/#25434/#25436 filter equal keys. M2289 dependencies at 11570-11573: index 3=M2228 exports UTC helper #25412 at 995548-995549. #26530 copies at 1030125, 0x37; full_day skips at 0x43, otherwise truthy times gate selected-date conversion at 0xed/0x142, writes only start_date/start_time/end_time at 0x12a/0x136/0x180; service call 1030200, 0x19d.
M2290/#26544/#26545/class #26546 binds #26551; reads parameter2.id at 1030699, 0x15, builds URL at 0x32, sends same body register 3 as PUT data at 1030707, 0x39.
clientRequestVariants.branch: Nineteen-name possible-key union only; seventeen names may be omitted by client difference filtering and/or branch selection, including range keys. Only id and employee_id are always written on executed update request paths after filtering. #26530 copies the difference, not the base; full_day truthy preserves null times, otherwise only truthy time fields trigger #25412 rewrites. Endpoint-level arbitrary callers remain untraced.

notes: The API's operation-level body remains open/unknown outside this identified form-submit construction. No server-side requiredness or enum claims are made.
